400	Fitting.	Combina.
401	In short...	Resumindo...
402	He walked seven days and didn't eat the whole way.	Andou sete dias e não comeu em todo o caminho.
403	He was hungry, so what did he do?	Estava com fome, então o que fez?
404	He took clumps of earth and put them in his mouth.	Pegou torrões de terra e pôs na boca.
405	He went on foot and reached Jerusalem.	Foi a pé e chegou a Jerusalém.
406	He met Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.	Encontrou Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.
407	He said to him, "I want to learn Torah."	Disse-lhe: "Quero aprender Torá."
408	He said to him, "Do you know how to read?"	Perguntou-lhe: "Você sabe ler?"
409	He said, "No."	Respondeu: "Não."
410	"Do you know how to learn anything?"	"Sabe estudar alguma coisa?"
411	He knew nothing at all.	Não sabia absolutamente nada.
412	He said, "Not good. Go to Rabbi Yehoshua."	Disse: "Assim não dá. Vá a Rabi Yehoshua."
413	He called Rabbi Yehoshua and said, "Take him."	Chamou Rabi Yehoshua e disse: "Leve-o."
414	Rabbi Yehoshua took him.	Rabi Yehoshua o levou.
415	Now, Rabbi Yehoshua didn't prepare dinner for him, and he was hungry.	Ora, Rabi Yehoshua não preparou o jantar para ele, e ele estava com fome.
416	So he was silent and didn't speak.	Então ficou calado, não falou.
417	The next morning he came to Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, who spoke with him,	Na manhã seguinte foi até Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, que falou com ele,
418	and saw how a bad smell came out of his mouth.	e viu como um mau cheiro saía da sua boca.
419	He said to him, "Did you eat?"	Perguntou-lhe: "Você comeu?"
420	He said, "No."	Respondeu: "Não."
421	He called Rabbi Yehoshua: "Why didn't you feed him?"	Chamou Rabi Yehoshua: "Por que não o alimentou?"
422	He said, "I thought you brought him to me; I thought he ate at your place."	Disse: "Pensei, foi o senhor que o trouxe para mim; achei que ele tinha comido com o senhor."
423	He said to him, "I sent him to you so that you would feed	Disse-lhe: "Eu o enviei a você para que você o alimentasse."
424	him."	—
425	Between the two of them, the poor man was lost.	Entre os dois, o pobre coitado se perdeu.
426	Well, he said to him, "May it be His will: just as a bad smell came out of your mouth,	Bem, disse-lhe: "Que seja a vontade de HaShem: assim como saiu mau cheiro da sua boca,
427	so too your fragrance will spread through Torah."	assim também o seu aroma se espalhará pela Torá."
428	He began to learn Torah and became like an ever-strengthening spring.	Começou a estudar Torá e tornou-se como uma fonte que se fortalece.
429	Through that same Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.	Por meio desse mesmo Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.
430	Well, a year went by, two years. His father says, "Where	Bem, passou-se um ano, dois anos. O pai dele diz: "Onde	
431	is this Eliezer?	está esse Eliezer?
432	Where is Eliezer?	Onde está Eliezer?
433	Maybe he went off to eat carob, who knows what he's doing."	Talvez tenha ido comer alfarroba, quem sabe o que está fazendo."
434	He said, "I'm going up to Jerusalem to disinherit him from all the property."	Disse: "Vou subir a Jerusalém para deserdá-lo de todos os bens."
435	He makes a will: all the brothers will receive, and he will receive nothing.	Faz um testamento: todos os irmãos receberão, e ele não receberá nada.
436	So he took his sons with him and went to Jerusalem.	Então levou os filhos consigo e foi a Jerusalém.
437	He went up to Jerusalem; Rabbi Eliezer's friends saw him and said	Subiu a Jerusalém; os amigos de Rabi Eliezer o viram e disseram
438	to Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, "His father has come."	a Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai: "O pai dele veio."
439	He said, "Yes, that's right."	Disse: "Sim, é verdade."
